justifications.durability: negative-control.log reddens all three added assertions at b5444d24ba with genuine failures: :169 and :190 catch a resume that launches for an already-landed head or for a landing in progress, and :244 catches the base's rewrite of the manifest status from complete to in-progress, so reinstating the base behaviour reddens each test.

justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py no longer defines an ancestry helper and reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:85 calls recovery_classification._head_on_primary_branch, the owner at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1191 that queue_landing.py:87 and obligations.py:3033 already reuse, so the added definition extends the existing owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the four-commit diff is inside the declared write paths, and no file outside them appears in any commit.
